jobs.title: Environmental Specialist
jobs.description:
About CDMS

CDMS is a premier Environmental Health and Safety Consulting company serving clients across California. We provide exceptional EH&S consulting services to help businesses navigate complex regulatory requirements while improving workplace safety and environmental compliance. Join our collaborative team and make a meaningful impact on California businesses. 

The Role

We're seeking an Environmental Health and Safety Consultant
with 2-10 years of industry experience to join our growing team in our Pleasanton, CA office. This role balances experience implementing EHS programs across a wide variety of industries while developing project management expertise. You'll manage EHS consulting projects, solve complex EHS compliance issues and serve as a mentor to junior specialists. 

What You'll Do

Manage EHS projects for our clients providing exceptional client service while maintaining project schedules and budgets. 
Prepare reports for our clients to follow guidance and regulations designed by EPA, DTSC, local CUPAs, Fire departments, Water boards and other federal, state and local government agencies 
Assist with permitting requirements and documentation (air quality, wastewater, Tiered Permitting, storm water, etc.) 
Conducting training for employees of client companies 
Conducting monitoring (air monitoring, soil sampling, etc.) 
Conducting compliance audits 
Providing ongoing compliance support to clients 
Providing various other support activities to clients to assist with their compliance efforts 

What You Bring

2-10 years of experience in environmental consulting or related industry 
Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Engineering, Chemistry, or related field (Master's degree a plus) 
The ability to work independently and lead a project team 
A high attention to detail and strong project management skills 
A personable demeanor and professional communication skills, both verbal and written 
Comfortable conducting trainings to groups of 10-40 people (10% of the job) 
Ability to handle multiple projects at the same time 
Computer skills, including proficiency in Word and Excel 

Why Work With Us

Opportunity to advance your environmental career in a role that balances strong technical knowledge with project management development 
Hybrid work arrangement available after initial onboarding period 
Collegial, supportive team environment that values innovation and excellence 
Comprehensive benefits including Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, 401K plan (Roth and Non-Roth options) with generous company match & HSA 
Make meaningful contributions that directly impact California companies and help their employees work safely 
Professional development opportunities and support for continued education and certifications 

COMPENSATION

$70,000-$140,000

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY 

CDMS is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer.
